business_reasoning: A primary territory owner knows the market and is accountable for it; a backup covers a gap and is a second-best fit.
Specialist knowledge raises the quality of the first conversation. Leads with no specialist rule take a neutral value rather than being penalised.
Micro businesses (1-19) belong with small-business RMs and established businesses (20-499) with commercial RMs; a mismatch is workable but not preferred.

preference_name: Continuity with a valid prior owner
business_reasoning: On a queue release or override, returning the lead to an RM who already knows it avoids repeating discovery. It never applies to the owner being reassigned away from.
Absolute headroom determines whether the RM can actually start work on the lead within the contact SLA.

preference_name: Workload balance within the candidate pool
normalization_rule: 100 * (pool_max_utilization - utilization) / (pool_max_utilization - pool_min_utilization); 50 when the pool utilization range is zero
business_reasoning: Spreading work across the eligible pool keeps territories evenly loaded; this is relative, where RPF-05 is absolute.
An explicitly stated language is honoured where possible. Leads that state nothing take a neutral value; language is never inferred.
